claim: The combined strategy reaches 82.6 percent correct abstention and 8.9 percent unnecessary rejection. It improves especially for out-of-validity and language-unavailable cases.
evidence: The simple threshold achieves 71.4 percent correct abstention but rejects 14.6 percent of answerable questions. The classifier reaches 79.8 percent and reduces unnecessary rejection to 10.2 percent.

claim: We select the combined strategy for adjudication and user testing.
